name: Netherite Gear
purpose: Crafting or processing material that moves the mod's progression chain toward machines, tools, upgrades, or resource production.
acquire: Craft or process it with smithing transform. Press R on the item in JEI/EMI for the exact ATM10 recipe.
use: Use it in crafting or automation chains; press U in JEI/EMI to see machines and recipes that consume it.
